title: JobStatus
description: CONTRACTS §5.3 polled-status object + §6.2 job states. Delivered both by polling `profile.get_status` and by optional host→JS push (§5.5) — one shared schema keeps the UI transport-agnostic. `error_code` carries a §8 registry code on failure (WORKER_CRASHED / JOB_TIMEOUT); `result` is the bounded job output on success. Absent slots are omitted, never null.

error_code.description: §8 registry code on FAILED (e.g. WORKER_CRASHED, JOB_TIMEOUT).

result.description: Bounded job output on success; must respect the 1 MiB bridge cap (§5.4) or be fetched via paging / artifact.open.
